title: Build Grave Accord and polish the public first-run experience
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Grave Accord implements cooperative gothic bullet hell with 66 boss identities (65 ordinary plus one secret), seven classes, 378 skills, 28 weapons, six maps and five modes. This remains feature-branch development; PR #14 stays draft.

First-time players can now choose a gentle Soldier/Baby/Solo preset, review its settings, and start without learning every setup option first. The optional introduction is labeled Tutorial and uses saved bindings. The home screen explains the encounter loop and shows the full original cover. Map previews use the selected difficulty geometry; difficulty cards explain assistance and form rules. Existing gear tiles show names, actual prices and equipped status, with separate coin/SP summaries. Artwork loading has progress and a useful failure message. Local Practice records are labeled as stored on this device.

Existing violet Alchemist catalytic eruptions have a bounded warning/burst shape and a static reduced-motion alternative. Controls, economy, purchase guards, random public boss progression, public/testing isolation and combat authority are preserved. Twelve of the original sixty encounters have implemented quality passes; forty-eight remain deferred during this polish phase. No new boss, map, mode, weapon, class path or General mobility expansion is included. Whole-boss human acceptance remains open.

Validation: the current follow-up passes the complete local gate with 756 tests, authored content/fifteen locales/RGBA, TypeScript, production build and 71 emitted atlas contracts. Current evidence is under reviews/public-polish-followup-2026-10-28/; the earlier First Watch source e6f3587 has its own 755-test local and CI evidence. Exact-source CI, new frozen public preview and Wiki publication receipts are recorded separately as they complete. Automated checks do not establish rendered, listening, native-language, physical-device or final human balance acceptance.

The Wiki is published from exact committed canonical pages and verified against all 18 page blobs, 34 image blobs and public image hashes. Existing frozen review roots are preserved. The older hosted protocol-4 Site and immutable protocol-13 Windows development release remain separate; no main merge, paid provisioning, deployment or contest submission is included.
